read_file.desc: Read file contents. Auto-detects encoding; returns binary as base64. Supports line ranges, head/tail shortcuts, byte limits, and line numbers.

params.head: Return only the first N lines.
params.tail: Return only the last N lines.
params.show_line_numbers: Prefix every line with its line number. Default: false
params.ranges: Array of [start_line, end_line] pairs to read multiple non-contiguous line ranges in one call (e.g. [[1,10],[50,60]]). Supersedes start_line/end_line. Ranges are read in a single pass for efficiency.

write_file.desc: Write content to a file, creating or overwriting it. Creates parent dirs automatically. Returns a unified diff when overwriting (show_diff defaults to true for existing files, false for new files).

params.create_dirs: Create missing parent directories. Default: true
params.show_diff: Return a unified diff of changes when overwriting. Default: true when overwriting an existing file, false when creating a new file (no existing content to diff).

append_to_file.desc: Append content to a file, creating it and any missing parent dirs if needed. Returns the new file size.

edit_file.desc: Surgical find-and-replace in a file. Two modes: single edit (old_str + new_str) or batch edits array — prefer batch for multiple changes to the same file. Returns a unified diff. Supports Go regex with $1,$2 back-references. Handles CRLF transparently — LF-only patterns match CRLF files and line endings are preserved. If old_str matches multiple locations, only the first is replaced (use replace_all=true or add more context). If pattern is not found, a near-miss probe shows surrounding context to help refine.

params.old_str: Text (or regex) to find — single-edit mode
params.use_regex: Treat old_str as a Go regular expression. Default: false
params.dry_run: Preview changes without writing. Default: false
params.context_lines: Unchanged context lines around each change in the diff. Default: 3.
params.edits: Batch mode: array of {old_str, new_str, use_regex?, replace_all?} edits applied sequentially.

delete_file.desc: Delete a single file. Use delete_directory to remove directories.

copy_file.desc: Copy a file. Creates parent dirs of the destination automatically.

params.overwrite: Overwrite if destination exists. Default: false

move_file.desc: Move or rename a file or directory. Cross-device safe (copy+delete).

params.overwrite: Overwrite if destination exists. Default: false

get_file_info.desc: Return metadata for a file or directory: type, size, modification time, permissions, and whether it is a symbolic link. Also includes line count for text files — useful to know before using start_line/end_line in read_file.

params.path: Path to the file or directory

path_exists.desc: Lightweight check whether a path exists and return its type (file/directory/symlink) and size. Use before read/write operations to branch on whether a path already exists — faster than read_file or get_file_info when you only need existence.

diff_files.desc: Compare two files and return a unified diff. Returns empty when files are identical. Cross-platform — prefer this over running diff via run_command.

params.context_lines: Context lines around each change. Default: 3.

calculate_checksum.desc: Calculate MD5, SHA1, or SHA256 checksum of one or more files. Cross-platform — prefer this over running md5sum/shasum/sha256sum via run_command.

create_symlink.desc: Create a symbolic link. Cross-platform. On Windows, creating symlinks may require elevated privileges or Developer Mode enabled.

params.source: The path that the symlink points to (the target file or directory)
params.link: The path of the symlink to create

compress_files.desc: Compress files or directories into an archive. Supports zip and tar.gz formats. Auto-detects format from output file extension.

params.paths: Array of file/directory paths to include in the archive
params.format: Archive format: "zip" or "tar.gz". Default: auto-detected from output extension.

extract_archive.desc: Extract a zip or tar.gz archive to a directory. Auto-detects format from file extension.

params.archive: Path to the archive file (zip or tar.gz)
params.output: Directory to extract into. Default: current working directory.
params.format: Archive format: "zip" or "tar.gz". Default: auto-detected from archive extension.
